newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa tightly mixed, AAs, crosses active.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa tightly mixed, AAs, crosses active.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa futures were tightly mixed in quiet Friday morning trade with activity centred on routine AA and cross trades. There was little outright business.
No fresh fundamental inputs were seen but traders said the firmer sterling against the dollar on a new UK interest rate hike might help New York's dollar-denominated cocoa futures.
Benchmark July stood unchanged at 995 stg a tonne after moving within a narrow four stg band. Other traded months were one down to two stg up.
Volume reached 1,516 lots. Of that, a third was crosses and out of that half were AAs, mainly in July.
One trade house was seen a seller in Dec/March. The spread stood at 11 stg by midday pause.
On the charts, cocoa was precariously poised and looked set to head lower but a firm close in the previous session may help to avert a breakdown in the short term, analysts said.
"Cocoa closed firm but it's very precariously poised. It looks pretty vulnerable," said Elli Gifford, an independent technical analyst.
"The firmness of the close may well allow it to get back to 1,010 but you've really got to see it at least at 1,030 stg before you can say that a breakdown is going to be averted," she said.
